prompt: simulate the following liquidity pool holds 10 bnb and there are 1000 token price for one token is one bnb and lp tax is 5% burn rate is 100% of the token that are sold. What happens if somebody sells 200 token what will the new price be
response: When 200 tokens are sold, the liquidity pool will adjust to maintain the balance. Since the burn rate is 100%, all 200 tokens will be removed from circulation. The remaining tokens will be 800, and the BNB will remain at 10. The new price will be 10 BNB / 800 tokens = 0.0125 BNB per token. Considering the LP tax, the effective price paid will be slightly higher, but the new price without tax is 0.0125 BNB per token.
